reviewer: Independent Codex GATE; bounded frozen offline implementation review; no operational grant
scope: Four frozen files: fixed-schema quiesce diagnostics, parent validation and ownership ordering, diagnostic tests, and stale-handoff test expectations. No re-audit of previously accepted components or policies.

SHOWN: All four frozen file hashes matched before independent tests. In-memory removal of only diagnostic additions reproduced the exact previous backend and installer hashes, isolating this turn from the broader dirty-worktree diff.

The transition retains the same target validation, signal tuple, shared ten-second deadline, polling, exit checks and restart path. Diagnostic marks do not add another lifecycle invocation, retry, forced stop or SIGKILL escalation against a container.
quiesce_report catches normal exceptions and returns only fixed schema/stage/boolean fields, with no exception class, message, stderr, token, arbitrary identifier or environment payload.

Parent validation requires an exact builtin dict/key set, exact schema, allowlisted stage, actual boolean types and exact allowed stage/flag combinations. Invalid reports are refused before receipt logging.
The parent selects either quiesce_report or legacy quiesce once, never both. A failed report or invalid report cannot authorize forward progress or clear pending ownership.

Even a confirmed child report requires fresh parent inventory, storage preservation and stopped-original verification. Only after those checks does the parent record ownership in memory and clear pending, before writing the diagnostic receipt. Diagnostic-write failure then blocks progress and preserves existing owned recovery.
A report confirmed by the child but rejected by parent fresh-state checks remains pending; its diagnostic is not a substitute for parent ownership confirmation.

Independent new-test-only execution passed 21 cases in 0.43 seconds, including a real bounded child JSON channel using synthetic backend state, lost acknowledgment, malformed/private report refusal, fresh-state drift and diagnostic-write recovery.

Both hash-bound offline saved-row replay cases passed: default and explicit replacement-ID inventory selections agree with and without the four prepared rows, and original observation equals the frozen baseline. No deterministic saved-metadata selection refusal was reproduced.

The reviewed handoff tests require old exact bindings to refuse changed consumers and keep a separate synthetic inert-dispatch test. They do not manufacture new approved inputs or restore runtime eligibility.
CLAIMED: Parent checkpoint reports 305 passing tests in 1.90 seconds across six files. This reviewer independently ran only the new diagnostic test file, not that broader slice.
UNVERIFIED: The original quiesce failure substep, signal dispatch/acknowledgment and any shell-forwarding causal explanation.
Live Docker/Go-template behavior, real signal handling, graceful shutdown success or runtime cure.
Diagnostic availability if the child is killed, cancelled, times out externally or cannot transfer its JSON result. Such cases retain the existing generic refusal and pending ownership.

isolated_delta_proof.method: Read frozen source into memory; reverse only optional diagnostic markers/method, strict report validator and parent diagnostic branch; compare SHA-256 with previously bound source. No source files written or reversed code executed.

independent_verification.command: env -i PATH=/usr/bin:/bin PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 PYTEST_DISABLE_PLUGIN_AUTOLOAD=1 ./.venv/bin/python -B -m pytest --noconftest -c /dev/null -p no:cacheprovider -q tests/test_companion_quiesce_diagnostics.py
independent_verification.isolation: New tests forbid subprocess.Popen, socket connect/connect_ex and DNS lookup; command responses, state and clock are synthetic. The child-channel test forks the existing bounded executor but never invokes Docker or a real service.
independent_verification.saved_replay_limits: Saved sanitized row responses bypass the native CLI and Go engine and cannot reconstruct transient original-time state, scheduling or acknowledgment. Replay includes separately hash-bound derived staged metadata, not an attestation of historical live state.

accepted_risks: command_attempted means entry into the command operation, not demonstrated signal dispatch. command_acknowledged means successful command return, not worker signal handling.

Diagnostic stages label the last entered substep, not underlying exception causes. A post-observation refusal may include timeout inside observation; it must not be interpreted as a more specific cause than recorded.
The added bounded receipt write consumes the existing overall budget; receipt failure intentionally blocks forward progress. The lifecycle deadline itself is unchanged.
Generic child failure can still produce no diagnostic. No inferred success, interruption ownership or retry is allowed in that case.

disposition.proof_required_next: No additional proof required for this offline patch acceptance. Any later runtime proposal requires separately valid exact-code/input bindings and explicit operational authorization; this review supplies neither and predicts no successful shutdown.
